# Setup

- `config.R`: project settings, paths, parameters, colors, ggplot theme
- Packages are installed in `01_data_preparation.Rmd`; here they are only checked and loaded

```{r config}
source("config.R")
check_and_load_packages(required_packages)
set.seed(random_seed)
```


# Load Data

Paired cohort from `01_data_preparation.Rmd`: raw counts, sample metadata, gene annotation.

```{r load_data}
paired_se <- readRDS(data_path("paired_se.rds"))

genes <- as.data.frame(rowData(paired_se))   # gene_id, gene_name, gene_type

dim(paired_se)
table(paired_se$condition)
```


# DESeq2 Pipeline

- Input: **raw counts** (Negative Binomial model needs counts)
- Paired design `~ patient + condition`: each patient is their own control; age and plate are constant within a patient and therefore absorbed
- Reference level: `normal` -> fold changes are cancer vs normal

## Low Expression Filter

- Genes with very few reads are mostly noise -> unstable estimates, more multiple testing
- Keep genes with >= 10 reads in >= 10 samples

```{r filter_low_expression}
dds <- DESeqDataSet(paired_se, design = ~ patient + condition)

keep <- rowSums(counts(dds) >= 10) >= 10
dds  <- dds[keep, ]

cat("Genes before filter:", length(keep), "| after filter:", nrow(dds), "\n")
```

## Normalization, Dispersion and Test

`DESeq()` runs three steps:

1. `estimateSizeFactors()` -> normalization (median-of-ratios), one size factor per sample
2. `estimateDispersions()` -> gene-wise variability (mean-variance relationship)
3. `nbinomWaldTest()` -> Negative Binomial GLM per gene, Wald test on `condition`

P-values are corrected for multiple testing with Benjamini-Hochberg (FDR) -> `padj`.

```{r deseq}
dds <- DESeq(dds)

res_df <- as.data.frame(results(dds, contrast = c("condition", "cancer", "normal")))

summary(sizeFactors(dds))
head(res_df[, c("log2FoldChange", "pvalue", "padj")])
```


# Threshold Selection

- Task: padj <= 0.05 and |FC| >= 1.2 (i.e. |log2FC| >= 0.263) -> "hundreds of genes"
- Number of DEGs for a grid of thresholds -> choose thresholds giving hundreds of genes

```{r threshold_grid}
padj_grid <- c(0.05, 0.01, 0.001)
fc_grid   <- log2(c(1.2, 1.5, 2, 3, 4))   # fold change -> log2 scale

# rows = padj thresholds, columns = log2FC thresholds
z_mat <- sapply(fc_grid, function(fc)
  sapply(padj_grid, function(p)
    sum(res_df$padj <= p & abs(res_df$log2FoldChange) >= fc, na.rm = TRUE)))

# long format: padj varies fastest, matching the column-wise order of z_mat
df_grid <- expand.grid(padj = padj_grid, log2FC = fc_grid)
df_grid$DEGs <- as.vector(z_mat)

ggplot(df_grid, aes(x = factor(round(log2FC, 2)), y = factor(padj), fill = DEGs)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  geom_text(aes(label = DEGs), color = "white", size = 3.5, fontface = "bold") +
  scale_fill_viridis_c() +
  labs(
    title = "Number of DEGs by Thresholds",
    x = "|log2FoldChange| threshold",
    y = "padj threshold",
    fill = "DEGs"
  )
```


# DEGs and Volcano Plot

Final padj <= `r padj_thresh` and |log2FC| >= `r lfc_thresh`

```{r classify_degs}
cat("padj <=", padj_thresh, "| |log2FC| >=", lfc_thresh, "\n")

# remove NAs (genes excluded by DESeq2's outlier / independent filtering) and classify
volcano_df <- res_df[!is.na(res_df$padj) & !is.na(res_df$log2FoldChange), ]
volcano_df$status <- "Not Significant"
volcano_df$status[volcano_df$padj <= padj_thresh &
                    volcano_df$log2FoldChange >= lfc_thresh]  <- "Up-regulated"
volcano_df$status[volcano_df$padj <= padj_thresh &
                    volcano_df$log2FoldChange <= -lfc_thresh] <- "Down-regulated"

degs_df <- volcano_df[volcano_df$status != "Not Significant", ]
deg_ids <- rownames(degs_df)

table(volcano_df$status)
```

```{r volcano_plot, fig.width=7, fig.height=6}
# padj == 0 would give Inf on the y-axis -> replace by smallest non-zero value
min_nonzero_padj <- min(volcano_df$padj[volcano_df$padj > 0])
volcano_df$neg_log10_padj <- -log10(pmax(volcano_df$padj, min_nonzero_padj))

p_volcano <- ggplot(volcano_df, aes(x = log2FoldChange, y = neg_log10_padj, color = status)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 1.2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = regulation_colors) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-lfc_thresh, lfc_thresh), linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(padj_thresh), linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  labs(
    title = "Volcano Plot (Cancer vs Normal)",
    subtitle = paste0("Thresholds: padj <= ", padj_thresh, ", |log2FC| >= ", lfc_thresh,
                      " (", nrow(degs_df), " DEGs)"),
    x = "log2(Fold Change)",
    y = "-log10(adjusted p-value)",
    color = "Regulation"
  )

p_volcano
save_plot(p_volcano, "task2_volcano_plot", width = 7, height = 6)
```


# Variance-stabilized Data for Tasks 3-5

- Correlations and distances need normalized **and** variance-stabilized values
- VST: same filter and size factors as the DEA; flattens the mean-variance relationship
- `blind = FALSE`: uses the design, so the real tumor/normal differences are not treated as noise

```{r vst}
vsd      <- vst(dds, blind = FALSE)
vst_expr <- assay(vsd)   # filtered genes x 104 samples, log2-like scale

dim(vst_expr)
```

```{r mean_sd_vst, fig.width=6, fig.height=4}
# Check: spread should be roughly constant along the mean (flat trend line)
gene_mean <- rowMeans(vst_expr)
gene_sd   <- apply(vst_expr, 1, sd)

plot(rank(gene_mean), gene_sd, pch = 16, cex = 0.3,
     col = adjustcolor(color_palette[["primary"]], alpha.f = 0.2),
     xlab = "Rank of gene mean expression (low to high)",
     ylab = "Standard deviation across samples",
     main = "VST: mean-SD relationship")
lines(lowess(rank(gene_mean), gene_sd), col = color_palette[["accent"]], lwd = 3)
```


# Save Results

- DEG table -> `results/` (small, part of the results)
- VST matrix -> `data/` (input for Tasks 3-5)

```{r save_results}
degs_out <- data.frame(
  gene_id        = deg_ids,
  gene_name      = genes[deg_ids, "gene_name"],
  log2FoldChange = degs_df$log2FoldChange,
  padj           = degs_df$padj,
  status         = degs_df$status
)

write.csv(degs_out, results_path("degs.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
saveRDS(vst_expr, data_path("vst.rds"))
```
